violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized. EHS observed 0ppm chlorine sanitizer solution concentration.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CFM agreed to discontinue using chlorine sanitizer dish machine until repaired. CFM stated they will use the 3 compartment sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize kitchen equipment and utensils using quat sanitizer solution until chlorine dish machine is repaired.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored over wrapped RTE assorted cheeses (whole parm, sliced Swiss, etc.) on speed rack inside of walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to bottom shelf of the speed rack.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tile over the dish machine area is missing and there is water leaking from the exposed pipes on to the floor. The pipes and ceiling are not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Repair the leak in the pipe and cover the area with a ceiling tile to repair the physical facilities and obtain compliance. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.
